annotations.title: A site's agent journeys: what each asks an agent to do, its model and schedule, and its latest verdict

description: Wraps GET /api/sites/{slug}/journeys. A site's agent journeys: what each asks an agent to do, its model and schedule, and its latest verdict. Call this to see how agents fare on the site: each journey is a Claude agent sent to do one job (sign up, find an answer) on a schedule. Its runs, step by step, are under /runs.
name: sites_by_slug_journeys

firstVisit.description: a weekly first visit with a fresh test account runs too, on each model

goal.description: what the agent is asked to do, in the team's words

kind.description: task: the agent does something (sign up, buy, post); answers: it answers questions from the site, read-only

chargeUsd.description: what the team was charged, US dollars; null when it wasn't

costUsd.description: what the model cost us, US dollars

verdict.description: pass: reached the goal (and its checks agree); fail: didn't; inconclusive: couldn't be judged (blocked, stopped early)

latest.description: its first model's latest run; null before the first

model.description: its first model (each of `models` runs on its own)

models.description: every model the journey runs on, each its own run, result and charge; /runs?model= reads one's runs

chargeUsd.description: what the team was charged, US dollars; null when it wasn't

costUsd.description: what the model cost us, US dollars

verdict.description: pass: reached the goal (and its checks agree); fail: didn't; inconclusive: couldn't be judged (blocked, stopped early)

latest.description: this model's latest run; null before its first

page.description: the journey's page on the dashboard

questions.description: an answer journey's questions; empty for a task

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call

title: A site's agent journeys: what each asks an agent to do, its model and schedule, and its latest verdict
